messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

['You have received a new update course form515 for your new semester Blackboard | Technology system', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'To upgrade your application: + Go to : http://www.2011-acrobat-reader-download.com + Download and upgrade your application.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'Your components downloaded from Comscore are all up-to-date.', 'As recommended by the Bain study, the Phase IV initiative will involve replacing all Macintosh/Apple-based computers (e.g. iMac and MacBook) with a Windows computer.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
